overlays.note: the law-rock: old-faith-entangled Thing ground where Skapti stands (C-LIE-05a)

enemies.grid_notes: Named faction agitator (crown-or-church hardliner) working to DISRUPT the verdict; wants a killing inside the ring to brand Grím LAW-BREAKER and foreclose the pardon. The trial's true adversary is procedural, not martial.
Tries to drag the melee INTO the law-circle so a stray blow damns Grím; punishes careless AoE near the ring (cols 7-10, rows 4-7).
West-side blade pressing from the far booth-row; the pincer that makes holding the ring without a kill genuinely hard.
Archer targeting the trial's witnesses in the booth-rows — down the witnesses and trial_arc_complete slips away.

neutrals.grid_notes: SKAPTI THE LAWSPEAKER on the law-rock (named; script) — speaks the case across the battle; protected, never targetable. If the ring is kept inviolate and the witnesses live, he completes the pardon, correcting his own Y-20 ruling (C-THING-01).
Trial witness from the ch4-01 wagons (deposition-bearer); must survive to enter the case. One of several the archer hunts.
Second trial witness; redundancy so one loss does not auto-fail trial_arc_complete.

objectives.primary: Hold the law-circle inviolate and protect Skapti and the witnesses until the case is spoken.
secondary: Land no killing blow inside the law_circle (preserve King of Men; avoid the LAW-BREAKER brand).
Keep both trial witnesses (n2/n3) alive (secures trial_arc_complete).
objectives.defeat: Grím falls, Skapti is reached, or all trial witnesses die.

kingsman.primary: Grím arrives with the crown's standing; the agitators are church-hardliners who fear a lawful vargdropi — hold the ring clean and let Skapti speak.

outlaw.primary: Grím stands in the ring still an outlaw in law; the trial IS the thing that could lift the sentence — same map, higher stakes: one killing inside the ring damns him twice over.

triggers.note: Skapti begins speaking; if nid_proof=held it is entered as the framed-proof lever (C-NID-EVIDENCE-01).

LAW-BREAKER brand (C-CLAN-03/04). The kill verb is disabled on law_circle tiles (cols 7-10 × rows 4-7 minus the rock), so this fires ONLY if the resolution script confirms the downing blow landed on a law_circle tile. Counter delta +1 to fire_stigma_count; the same resolution script sets hjortdal_fate=thing_broken, foreclosing King of Men on the spot.

A player unit felled on a law_circle tile is blood spilled on no-kill ground before the whole Thing — sung the same way; the resolution script routes it through the LAW-BREAKER brand path (fire_stigma_count +1, hjortdal_fate=thing_broken).
With the chief agitator down OUTSIDE the ring and the circle kept clean, the disruption fails. Downing him INSIDE the ring would itself trigger the LAW-BREAKER brand.
If nid_proof=held, the commission-tally naming the throne is read into the case — the strongest push toward the pardon.

If Skapti survives on the law-rock with the ring inviolate and the witnesses alive, the case completes: trial_arc_complete=true; the resolution script also sets hjortdal_fate=law_upheld and boosts hjortdal_trust.

designer_notes.height_gimmick: The decisive geometry here is LEGAL, not elevational — the map is dead flat (elevation 0 everywhere, even the law-rock), so nothing is a wall and nothing is high ground. The only tiles that change combat are the law_circle ring, where the KILL verb is disabled: inside it you may down, shove, or hold but never slay, and a single killing blow there is sung as LAW-BREAKER by every clan at once (C-CLAN-03/04), foreclosing King of Men. Where every other map makes elevation the puzzle, this one makes a rule the terrain — the flat law-rock is ground the fight must protect, not take.
designer_notes.witness_setup: Maximum witnesses in the game: the assembled Thing lines every booth-row (rows 0-1 and 10-11) and cannot be silenced, so witness_rule is always_sung — there is no killing your way to an Unsung account here. A killing inside the ring is witnessed by the whole realm at once and the plain outside is wall-to-wall eyes; the player cannot prevent it, only choose what the trial's evidence records. The one thing worth guarding is the witnesses' lives (n2/n3), whom the archer e4 hunts.
designer_notes.intent: SHOWCASE and the King of Men hinge (C-THING-01, C-END-01): fighting erupts around the law-ring while Skapti speaks the case that could lift vargdropi status. nid_proof=held is the strongest lever; trial_arc_complete and hjortdal_fate turn on whether the ring is kept inviolate and the ch4-01 witnesses survive.
